span.p:
Lollipop = interface the class provides. Each interface declares
exactly the public operations listed in its class (IAuthService,
ITokenService, IPasswordHasherService, IRefreshTokenStore).
AuthService uses the other three through its private fields
(constructor injection). Lifetimes are from Program.cs.
GenerateAccessToken returns the named tuple (Token, Expiration).
PasswordHasherService: BCrypt, work factor 11.
Refresh tokens live in memory and are lost on restart.
If the database is unreachable, AuthService reads the
in-code _lazySeedUsers list instead (IsDbAvailableAsync).
